title: SANSKERTA, KALIGRAFI ARAB, MISTIK, NAZI, DAN SUNDA EMPIRE: Ketika Bahasa, Simbol, Ritual, Sejarah, dan Ideologi Bertemu

open_questions: A fuller primary-source and specialist bibliography is needed for the historical development and regional meanings of swastika variants.

method_note: Distinguish language from script, calligraphy from talismanic use, documented ritual from supernatural efficacy, historical swastika traditions from Nazi appropriation, and historical Sunda polities from the modern Sunda Empire movement. Similar names or symbols do not establish continuity or organizational connection. The appended clarification note corrects oversimplifications without silently rewriting the published article.
